name: read-visibility
body: The measure of whether a completed mutation is visible to a subsequent reader: visible when a read issued immediately after the mutation, in a new process, returns the post-mutation state — with no flush, no session-end, and no re-scan. Distinct from `projection-consistency`: a projection may be consistent with its sources yet unreachable to a reader (locked, buffered, or not yet applied); read-visibility is the stronger, reader-facing property.
